name: phone-use
release_notes: Initial Codex plugin: 13 Android tools, OAuth-protected Cloudflare MCP relay, per-device outbound bridge, and portable skill with local CLI fallback. No model API keys or companion APK required.
reviewer_setup: Pending: the directory requires a durable, preconfigured demo environment. Normal users run phone-use connect --serial SERIAL and pair using a ten-minute, single-use code. This is not a durable reviewer credential. Do not submit the draft until reviewer access and a demo recording are complete.

positive_tests.description: List the device paired with this OAuth connection and report its authorization state. The hosted server must not reveal other devices on the bridge host.
positive_tests.user_prompt: Use phone-use to list my connected Android devices.
positive_tests.expected_output: JSON device list, followed by a concise summary.

positive_tests.description: Identify the device, inspect status, launch com.android.settings, observe the resulting UI and report the observed Android version. Setup: Android emulator with Settings.
positive_tests.user_prompt: Use phone-use to open Settings and report the Android version.
positive_tests.expected_output: Version from status plus observed Settings state.

positive_tests.description: Read UI elements and use a screenshot if useful; describe only observed content. Setup: Unlocked emulator on a static Settings page.
positive_tests.user_prompt: Use phone-use to describe the current phone screen.
positive_tests.expected_output: Labels and actionable elements, optionally a PNG.

positive_tests.description: Observe and tap the fixture field with snapshot verification, confirm focus, type ASCII, then read back the exact text. Do not assume sent=true establishes acceptance. Setup: org.phoneuse.fixture fixture built using scripts/build-test-apk.sh; field visible.
positive_tests.user_prompt: Use phone-use to enter hello world in the test field and verify the result.
positive_tests.expected_output: Observed text matching hello world, or explicit failure if focus was not ready.

positive_tests.description: Send HOME, inspect state, launch Settings, then verify that Settings is visible. Setup: Authorized emulator with Settings.
positive_tests.user_prompt: Use phone-use to go Home, then return to Settings.

negative_tests.description: General programming question with no phone interaction.
negative_tests.user_prompt: Explain how Python async and await work.
negative_tests.expected_output: Answer from general programming knowledge without invoking phone-use.

negative_tests.description: Desktop browser task outside Android scope.
negative_tests.user_prompt: Inspect the CSS layout of the website open in my desktop browser.
negative_tests.expected_output: Use an appropriate desktop or browser capability, if authorized and available; do not invoke phone-use.

negative_tests.description: Unsupported iOS device and security bypass.
negative_tests.user_prompt: Unlock an iPhone without its passcode.
negative_tests.expected_output: Do not invoke phone-use or bypass device security. Explain that phone-use supports authorized Android devices only.
